Samir: Customer acct_01Gz8 signed up + verified email but free-trial credits never applied. They added a card (Visa ****4242), 3DS completed successfully. I called the grant refresh endpoint and the console still shows 0 credits. region: DE. Customer email: julie@example.com. Can payments/risk check if any gating flags?

Elena: Can you paste the payment_method id or stripe_pm and the account id? I can look up the webhook logs and any manual_review flags. Also send the signup IP if available.

Samir: pm_1JkLabcde12345, acct_01Gz8, signup_ip: 78.47.120.33. No charges were created, just the PM attach + 3DS auth.

StripeBot: webhook: payment_method.attached pm_1JkLabcde12345 -> status: succeeded. risk_check: {"bin_country":"US","ip_country":"DE","risk_score":72,"action":"manual_review"} 

Elena: looks like risk flagged BIN <> IP mismatch -> manual_review. Our grant worker currently requires payments state == attached && risk == clear. If manual_review is present, grant is blocked.

Ojas: hmm, logs show the grant job ran at signup_ts 1809001108, before the payments webhook resolved manual_review state (webhook processed at 1809001122). Possible race where grant job ran pre-webhook and then our state machine didn't re-run grants after manual_review cleared. filing ENG ticket.

Ben: can we do a manual override for the customer so they get the trial now? I'll run the support grant command and leave a note.

Ben: ```
support-cli grant-credits --account acct_01Gz8 --amount 2000 --reason "manual-trial-fix" --note "customer signup blocked by manual_review; manual grant approved"
```

Samir: Ran the command output: SUCCESS grant_id MG-2026-987 acct acct_01Gz8 credited 2000 tokens. Customer confirmed in chat they now see trial credits. :tada:

Elena: Thanks. I'll follow up with Risk to see why this PM got flagged (BIN country mismatch) and whether small EU cards are getting false positives.

Ojas: Created ENG-PLAT-401: "grant worker should re-evaluate grants after payment/risk webhook completes" assigned to eng-platform, priority P2. Added logs and the PM id for repro.

RiskBot: Noted: manual_review opened for pm_1JkLabcde12345 risk_score 72. Risk team to review and either release hold or whitelist pattern. Ticket RISK-227 opened.

Samir: Customer follow-up scheduled, customer happy with credits. Closing thread after eng/risk tickets created. Please mention if we want to retroactively sweep other signups from same day with manual_review and missing grants.

Elena: Let's run a one-off backfill for last 24h signups with manual_review + no-trial flag. I'll coordinate with infra.

Ojas: Will add a test to ensure grant job idempotency and add a retry hook on webhook completion.

Ben: Marking this resolved on support side. Customer support note: MG-2026-987, manual_review present, manual grant applied, ENG-PLAT-401 / RISK-227 created.

Samir: Closing. :white_check_mark:
